findings.detail: The flagged row combines Denali with a 347,854 amount from a non-holding commitments/funded-amount note instead of the current Denali SOI row.
The valid current Denali holding is Class A Units with cost 340,994 and fair value 356,603 in the SOI, so the separate low-fair-value Denali row should not stand as a current position.

rationale: Class 2 row-level adjudication. The extracted flagged row reports Denali Equity Holdings LLC with cost 347,854,000 and fair value 1,544,900, triggering X08. Raw source does not show that as a Denali holding. The current SOI row for Denali is Class A Units with cost 340,994 and fair value 356,603 (thousands), while 347,854 appears in a commitments/funded-amount note for Other Equity, not as the current position fair-value row. The flag is therefore a real data error in the extracted holding row, not a genuine distressed position.
